name: Glass Thoughts
source:
Witold Miller – a young Polish-German prosecutor is investigating a series of tedious cases around the Free City of Gdansk. This tiny city, being a melting point of different cultures and political movements, cannot be considered a safe place in the middle of the roaring 20’s. 

Soon, Witold realizes that in order to solve the mystery of a murder, he needs to dive into the depths of his own psyche.

[From [url=https://tojak.itch.io/glass-thoughts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维托尔德·米勒（Witold Miller）——一位年轻的波兰裔德国检察官正在调查格但斯克自由市周围的一系列繁琐案件。这座小城市是不同文化和政治运动的熔点，在喧嚣的20年代中期，不能被认为是一个安全的地方。

很快，维托尔德意识到，为了解开谋杀之谜，他需要深入自己的心灵深处。

[来自[url=https://tojak.itch.io/glass-thoughts]Itch.io[/url]]
